children: Three Lions announced that holders may elect to separately trade the ordinary shares and warrants from its units beginning on or about September 17, 2026.
Holders of units can elect to separate units into ordinary shares and warrants starting on or about Sept 17, 2026.
Separated ordinary shares expected to trade on Nasdaq under symbol TLAC; warrants under TLACW.
Units not separated will continue trading on Nasdaq under symbol TLACU.
Unit holders must have their broker contact Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company to effect separations.
